mentions.name: VC firm automation with LLMs
mentions.description: This project uses LLMs to automate various operations and tasks at a small VC firm, helping a small team handle its many different tasks.
mentions.problem: A small team has many different tasks to do and limited capacity.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on methods to automate my VC firm. We have a small team and many different tasks to do. I’ve had success with using LLMs to help us automate various projects.
